description: INEC - Peso Neto de las importaciones de bienes acumulado Agosto 2003-2020 provides national import net-weight statistics organised by economic use of goods. The provider is INEC Panama / national open-data portal. Geographical and temporal coverage: The Panama INEC collection covers accumulated August figures for 2003 to 2020. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution, read from the portal's dataset metadata on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Commodity weights inform freight context; the collection does not identify transport routes or infrastructure capacity. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
